result:
Summary: According to the sources, DRAGIN is a lightweight RAG framework that can be incorporated into any Transformer-based LLMs without further training, fine-tuning, or prompt engineering. The framework leverages the self-attention mechanisms inherent in Transformer-based LLMs to dynamically decide when and what to retrieve, significantly improving the relevance and accuracy of generated text. The sources emphasize that DRAGIN's integration is seamless and does not require additional training or adaptation of the underlying LLM.
